hud.mitrasautosprinter.editor.title: HUD Editor
hud.mitrasautosprinter.editor.instructio: Drag to move - Arrow keys nudge (Shift = bigger steps) - Double-click to center - ESC to save.
R on the HUD to reset - G toggles grid snapping - Ctrl disables snapping.
message.mitrasautosprinter.hud_failed: Mitra's Auto Sprinter: the sprint HUD failed to draw and is now hidden. Open the HUD editor to reset it, or reconnect to the world.
mitrasautosprinter.config.condition.text: Only editable in Text display mode
mitrasautosprinter.config.condition.icon: Only editable in Icon display mode
mitrasautosprinter.config.condition.cust: Only editable with the Custom anchor
mitrasautosprinter.mitrasautosprinter.sp: The master switch for auto sprint. Everything else fine-tunes it.
Automatically holds the sprint key while you move forward. Toggle it in game with your Toggle Auto Sprint key.
mitrasautosprinter.mitrasautosprinter.hu: Look, position, and colors of the sprint indicator. For quick changes, drag the indicator directly in the HUD editor.
Whether the indicator is shown at all, and in which style it appears.
Show or hide the sprint indicator entirely.
Show the indicator as a text label or as the speed effect icon.
When the indicator is visible on screen.
Draw a background box behind the indicator. Text mode only; the box color is set under Style & Colors.
Where the indicator sits, and how big the icon is. Use the HUD editor to drag it anywhere with snapping, or pick a preset position.
Where the HUD sits on screen. Pick a preset, or choose Custom position and set HUD X / HUD Y below.
Horizontal position from 0.0 (left edge) to 1.0 (right edge); stays put when the GUI scale changes. Only used with the Custom position setting.
Vertical position from 0.0 (top edge) to 1.0 (bottom edge); stays put when the GUI scale changes. Only used with the Custom position setting.
Size multiplier for the icon (0.25 - 8). You can also resize it in the HUD editor with the mouse wheel or +/- keys.
Size multiplier for the text label (0.25 - 8). You can also resize it in the HUD editor with the mouse wheel or +/- keys.
Opens the editor where you can drag the HUD anywhere. It snaps to screen edges, center lines, and an optional grid (press G).
Text styling and the colors used for each indicator state. Colors and the text color mode only apply in Text display mode.
Label color while you are sprinting (green by default).
Label color when auto sprint is turned off (gray by default).
Label color while something is blocking the sprint, e.g. low hunger (yellow by default).
Color of the background box drawn behind the indicator. Enable the box with Background Box under Visibility & Mode.
Draw the label with a drop shadow.
mitrasautosprinter.mitrasautosprinter.te: The text shown for each HUD state.
Text shown when auto sprint is turned off.
Text shown briefly while joining a world or server.
Text shown briefly while waiting for terrain, e.g. after a teleport.
%s is replaced with the reason the sprint is blocked.
mitrasautosprinter.mitrasautosprinter.re: The text shown for each reason the sprint can be blocked. These fill in the Blocked Format label.
Shown when you are not moving forward.
Shown when the game restricts sprinting, e.g. while blind.
Shown while riding a vehicle that cannot sprint.
Shown when your hunger is too low to sprint.
Shown while wading in water too shallow to sprint in.
Shown while using an item that prevents sprinting.
Shown while flying with an elytra.
Shown when a wall or obstacle stops your sprint.
